transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well, I guess what brings me in is… since I stopped working, I just don’t seem to slow down much. I’m up and moving around all day, going from one little job to the next, like I still have a crew waiting on me or something. It’s not terrible, I don’t think, but it’s enough that I thought maybe I should ask someone about it.
Have you noticed needing less sleep lately, or feeling rested with just a few hours of sleep?

Hmm… no, I don’t think so. I mean, I sleep okay as far as I can tell. I haven’t noticed getting by on just a few hours and feeling great or anything like that. If anything, I’d say it seems pretty normal for me.
Have you noticed feeling unusually upbeat, overly confident, or especially energetic lately?

I wouldn’t say unusually upbeat or overconfident, no. I mean, I feel pretty much like myself. The energetic part… maybe a little, in the sense that since I stopped working I just keep moving all day, going from one small job to the next around the house. It’s like I still feel like there’s a crew waiting on me, if that makes sense. But I don’t think I’m feeling grand or anything like that.

Have you had any period recently where you felt a significant increase in your mood, like being unusually happy or irritable, along with a big increase in your energy or activity level, lasting several days or more?

No, I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve had days where I’m busy or a little keyed up, I guess, but not like several days of being unusually happy or irritable with a big jump in energy. At least not that I’ve noticed. Does that sound like what you’re asking?
Have you noticed feeling down, sad, or losing interest in things you used to enjoy since you stopped working?

I don’t think so, not really. I mean, stopping work has been an adjustment, sure, but I wouldn’t say I’ve been down or sad in a big way. And I still do things around the house and keep busy. Maybe I’m still figuring out the routine, but I don’t think I’ve lost interest in things, if that makes sense.
Have you had any period, even just a day or two, where you felt unusually happy, irritable, or really energetic, even if it didn’t last very long?

Not really, no. I mean, I have moments where I’m in a decent mood or I get going on chores and feel kind of wound up, but I wouldn’t call it unusually happy or irritable. And it’s not like a clear day or two where I’m suddenly full of energy in a different way. At least, I don’t think so.

Have you ever had a time when your mood was noticeably different from usual — maybe unusually cheerful or easily annoyed — along with a clear increase in your energy or activity, even if it only lasted a day or two?

I don’t think so, no. I’m trying to think if there was anything like that, but nothing really stands out as me being different from my usual self. I can get a little annoyed like anyone, or have a good day, but not with some clear jump in energy or activity. I hope that answers what you’re asking.
Have you ever had a period, even just a few hours, where you felt unusually excited, unusually irritable, or so energetic that others might have noticed you were acting differently?

No, I don’t think so. I mean, maybe I’ve had times where I’m a little more keyed up or irritated than usual, but not in a way where someone would say I was acting different. At least, nobody’s ever pointed that out to me. I’m not sure if that’s the kind of thing you mean.
Have you had any distinct periods, even just a few hours, where you felt noticeably more upbeat, irritable, or energetic in a way that was different from your usual self—even if others didn’t notice?

I don’t think I’ve noticed anything like that, no. I mean, I have normal ups and downs, sure, but not a distinct few hours where I felt like a different version of myself or unusually energetic. At least nothing that comes to mind. Is that the kind of thing you’re asking?

Have you ever had a time, even just a few hours long, when your mood was clearly different from your usual self—like feeling unusually cheerful, easily annoyed, or so energetic—that you noticed it yourself, even if others didn’t?

I understand. I really haven’t noticed that in myself, no. I have regular moods, like anyone, but I can’t think of a time where it felt clearly different or like I was unusually cheerful or wound up. If anything like that happened, it didn’t stand out to me.

Have you ever had a time, even just a couple of hours, when you felt a sudden or distinct change in your mood—like feeling unusually excited, unusually irritable, or so energetic—that you yourself noticed, even if only briefly?

I really don’t think so, doctor. I’ve been trying to think of anything like that, even just for a couple hours, and nothing stands out to me as a sudden shift like that. I get annoyed or in a better mood sometimes like anyone, but not in a way I’d call unusual or really different from me. Does that answer it okay?

Have you ever had a period, even just a day or two, where you felt a clear change in your mood—like being unusually upbeat, easily annoyed, or especially energetic—that was different enough from your usual self that you noticed it, even if it didn’t last very long?

I don’t believe so, no. I’ve been thinking about it as you’ve asked, and I can’t point to a day or two where I felt clearly different from my usual self like that. I might have a good day or get irritated now and then, but nothing that seemed unusual or stood out to me. I hope that makes sense.

Have you ever had a time, even just a few hours, when you felt a sudden or distinct change in your mood—like feeling unusually excited, unusually irritable, or so energetic—that you yourself noticed, even if only briefly?

I’m sorry, I know you’re asking it a careful way, but no, I still can’t think of a time like that. I’ve had normal ups and downs, but nothing sudden or distinct that I noticed as being really out of character for me. If I’m missing what you mean, you can tell me, but I don’t think that’s happened.

Have you ever had a time, even just a few hours, when you felt a sudden or distinct change in your mood—like feeling unusually excited, unusually irritable, or so energetic—that you yourself noticed, even if only briefly?

I understand why you’re checking, and I don’t want to give the wrong answer, but… no, I haven’t noticed anything like that. Not a sudden mood change or feeling unusually energized for a few hours. I have ordinary good or bad moods, sure, but nothing that felt distinct or out of character to me.
Have you ever had a time — even just a few hours — when you felt unusually good, unusually irritable, or so full of energy that it felt different from your usual self, even if only briefly?

I don’t think so, doctor. I mean, I’ve had good moods or gotten annoyed like anyone, but nothing where I thought, “This isn’t like me,” or felt unusually full of energy for a few hours. I hope that’s the kind of thing you’re asking about.
Have you ever had a time — even just a few hours — when you felt unusually good, unusually irritable, or so full of energy that it felt different from your usual self, even if only briefly?

I guess I’d still say no, not really. I’m trying to think of even a short stretch like that, but I don’t remember feeling unusually good or keyed up in a way that seemed unlike me. I get irritated now and then, but it feels pretty normal, not like a sudden change. Does that answer what you mean?

Have you ever had a time — even just a couple of hours — when you felt noticeably more confident, unusually cheerful, or so energetic that it stood out to you, even a little, as different from your usual self?

I’m trying to be careful with that… but no, I don’t think I’ve had that. Maybe I’ve felt pleased with myself once in a while, like anyone, but not noticeably more confident or cheerful in a way that stood out as different. And I don’t really get those bursts of energy like that, at least not that I’ve noticed. Is that answering it okay?
Have you ever had a time — even just a few hours — when you felt unusually good, unusually irritable, or so full of energy that it felt different from your usual self, even if only briefly?

I don’t believe so, no. I know I’ve answered that a few times, but I’m just not coming up with anything like that — not a few hours where I felt unusually good or irritable or full of energy in a way that seemed different from me. I have normal ups and downs, I guess, but nothing that stands out. Is that okay?
